svg.text: The whole plan: agents write, code decides, two libraries grow and are used
papers, supplements, released data; one at a time, never committed
Per source: agents write, nothing else
anchors found, values as printed, groups and
n consistent; figure code reruns to the
same values; synonyms found in the source
record, figure code and readings, terms, derivations; audit generated by code
documented tables of records, mappings, derivations, checks and comparisons, with the library versions used;

people and agents query a release, synthesize, test hypotheses and cite rows; nothing they write enters a release
